description: This Java class 'ClusterStatus' models the status of an Akka cluster, including reachable/unreachable members, leader, roles, and seen-by addresses. It provides methods for constructing, accessing, and serializing cluster status information as JSON.

classes.name: ClusterStatus
classes.description: Immutable class representing the status of an Akka cluster, including members' reachability, leader, roles, and metadata, with JSON serialization capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a new ClusterStatus instance with given sets of reachable, unreachable, seen-by addresses, leader, own roles, and roles status.

methods.name: getReachable
methods.description: Returns the set of reachable cluster members.

methods.name: getUnreachable
methods.description: Returns the set of unreachable cluster members.

methods.name: getSeenBy
methods.description: Returns the set of members that have seen this cluster state.

methods.name: getLeader
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the leader's address if present.

methods.name: getOwnRoles
methods.description: Returns the set of roles that this member has.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Returns the set of ClusterRoleStatus objects representing roles status.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ClusterStatus object into a JSON object.
